speaker: nova
line: My plating's whole again. They did it carefully. I can feel the difference.

speaker: nova
line: Another shove. You didn't ask if I could take it. I didn't need to cool down. I'm still hot.

speaker: kaelen
line: Low risk, low pay. That's the math. Don't let it stall you, Shiny.

speaker: nova
line: They'll have to scrape the paint from my ribs. I don't like the way it's peeling, Captain. My frame spars, technically.

speaker: nova
line: They left. You're the one who'll see me whole again. I'm not used to that yet.

speaker: nova
line: Captain. We're back. You took the long way. I like it. I like it a lot.

speaker: nova
line: Long way still to run. Young Tam once worked my intakes. Soft bristle rotary. Took forever to stop leaking coolant.

speaker: nova
line: Scuff marks on my stern. They’ll grind them out. Not because I ask. They’ll do it anyway.

speaker: kaelen
line: It's off. No money. And someone's got a hole in their trust where your name fits.

speaker: kaelen
line: This one paid right for the risk. Don't expect that every time, Shiny.

speaker: kaelen
line: They were told we didn't finish. That's a cost I don't usually count, Shiny.

speaker: kaelen
line: Big payout for real danger. That's the math, and it's worth it.

speaker: nova
line: Docked. Scraped the nose on the bay door. Who's going to polish that off before morning?

speaker: kaelen
line: It's here, and it's all we got. Not enough to move, but enough to keep waiting.

speaker: kaelen
line: That one paid well, and it was actually dangerous. Numbers don't lie, Shiny.

speaker: nova
line: Drive's still hot. You didn't ask, but I'm counting the seconds between now and the next break.

speaker: kaelen
line: No credit shows up. That’s the cost of not finishing, Shiny.

speaker: kaelen
line: No contract, no risk, no cut. You're right to walk.

speaker: nova
line: This station's got my name on the manifest. I remember every time we come back. You don't.

speaker: kaelen
line: Someone had to know you didn't finish. That's the cost this time.

speaker: nova
line: We've a great deal of nothing ahead of us. My viewport's got a film. You'll want to scrape it. Not the glass — the film.

speaker: kaelen
line: That was a good number, and it had teeth. I'll take that again.

speaker: nova
line: They cleaned my joints. You’d think they’d be more careful with the ones that move.

speaker: nova
line: My ribs are bruised and I'm not even sure why. You didn't have to go that hard, Captain. My frame spars, technically.

speaker: kaelen
line: No penalty, no pay. You're right to walk. Some jobs aren't worth the breath.

speaker: nova
line: Long crossing, and no one else in it. This seal's been stiff since the last port. You could try working it loose. With your hands.

speaker: kaelen
line: Safe work doesn't pay, Shiny. It just keeps the lights on — and that's not worth a whole lot.

speaker: nova
line: We're on the arm. I'm not dead. You could've killed me. I'm still here.

speaker: kaelen
line: That one's up there. You know what they call this kind of job? A favor.

speaker: kaelen
line: Turned it down. Good. You're not the one who'll be stuck with the mess if you take it.
